title: Exact head-dependent exchange with hydrology-before-management clipping
purpose: Reintroduce the qualified UserDemand priority rule into the DUMMY-04 trapezoidal head-dependent exchange as an exact piecewise coupled problem, before testing any iterative algorithm.

frozen_problem.management_min_level: managed withdrawal may not drive h1 below hmin
frozen_problem.hydrology_priority: if the zero-withdrawal coupled hydrology yields h1 <= hmin, U=0; hmin does not clip the physical exchange
frozen_problem.physical_floor: if the zero-withdrawal coupled solution lies below datum, fail closed rather than invent a dry-boundary law

exact_regimes: FULL: fixed-U solution at U=R has h1 >= hmin, so U=R
CURTAILED: h1(U=0) > hmin > h1(U=R), so h1=hmin and 0<U<R
ZERO: h1(U=0) <= hmin but remains at or above datum, so U=0
INFEASIBLE: h1(U=0) < datum, so the frozen physical surrogate itself is outside its admissible water-storage domain
derived_hypotheses: The FULL/CURTAILED/ZERO regime can therefore be selected without numerical iteration.
In CURTAILED, h1=hmin, V=C*dt*(((h0+hmin)/2)-hgw), and U=A*(h0-hmin)-V.
Curtailing management can change the physical exchange because V depends on the resulting Basin level; saved management water is therefore not generally one-for-one retained storage.
The exact regime solution is continuous at the FULL-CURTAILED and CURTAILED-ZERO boundaries.

experiments.M1: full-demand regime reproduces the DUMMY-04 fixed-U solution
experiments.M2: curtailed regime pins the end level at hmin and satisfies exchange plus water balance exactly
experiments.M3: zero-delivery regime leaves physical exchange uncurtailed when hydrology alone reaches/breaches hmin
experiments.M4: a case where curtailment raises Basin level also increases infiltration relative to a frozen-exchange sequential clipping approximation
experiments.M5: FULL-to-CURTAILED boundary is continuous in U, V and h1
experiments.M6: CURTAILED-to-ZERO boundary is continuous in U, V and h1
experiments.M7: physical-floor violation fails closed rather than using management clipping to repair hydrological infeasibility
experiments.M8: regime classification agrees with a dense independent request sweep against the exact fixed-U end-level function

interpretation_rules: This is an exact complementarity-style solution of the frozen linear trapezoidal surrogate, not a Ribasim allocation solver.
Hydrology-before-management means management is the adjustable quantity; it does not mean groundwater exchange is independent of the management-induced level.
No iterative coupling method is qualified in DUMMY-05.
A later work unit may test active-set/Picard/Newton-like algorithms against this exact piecewise oracle.
forbidden: no claim of real Ribasim allocation equivalence
